## Facebook lead form intake
Meta calls `GET /webhook/meta-leads` once to subscribe, then `POST`s each new lead. The POST is accepted only with a valid `X-Hub-Signature-256` (HMAC of the raw body with the app secret). The lead itself is read from the Graph API with the Page token, mapped to the same inquiry shape as the form and email, and sent to **Process inquiry**.
